answers.nested_question: my order payment was unsuccessful... what now?
answers.nested_info: First, confirm with your bank that the card you're using has 3D Secure (also known as MasterCard SecureCode or Verified by Visa), which implies it's enabled for online transactions. If your card is 3D secure and you are still encountering this issue, please contact your bank for assistance. An unsuccessful transaction is typically the consequence of one of the following factors:
nested_answers: The OTP has not been applied within the required interval.​
The bank card you're using is from an international bank, which rain cannot process.
The card is being used or was used under a separate rain account.​
You've surpassed your online spending limit or have insufficient cash.

answers.nested_question: how long will it take for my SIM to activate?
answers.nested_info: Your SIM(s) should be activated within two hours of successfully completing RICA. We'll send you an SMS to notify you when your SIM is operational. You can also go in to your myrain account and search for a green tick next to your SIM.
